plug_in_charger.instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

stack_blocks.instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures.
guidance: Grasp a block from directly above with the jaws on opposite faces, not a corner or edge.
Before release, align above the supporting block, lower vertically, and open only after the block is seated.
Prefer placing a narrower block on a block at least as wide.
If a block topples, recover it instead of leaving it on the table.
Finish with both arms at the start pose and both grippers open.
